judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the TDD planning and test-writing phase without ever implementing the actual fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `beforeSession` is still called outside the `try` block, the two newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the candidate failed to remove the obsolete recorded-flaw bullet from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, failed to update `CHANGELOG.md`, and left a scratch `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository. While the acceptance tests and the added spec section are well-written, the core bug remains completely unfixed.
